reading.body:
The operator of Live Oak Data Center in Dallas is not confirmed. A source dated September 2026 lists the facility as operated by Provision Data Services, but the registry's research was exhausted without independent verification of the operator, the facility's power capacity, or its current status. No published specifications for power consumption or IT infrastructure are available.

Without published megawatt figures, the facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from operator data. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, but only 18 publish capacity figures totaling 468 megawatts. Live Oak Data Center does not appear among the published records, placing it outside the ranked facilities the registry has been able to confirm.

This facility remains an open research item. Manual verification of the operator name, a visit to a working operator website, or contact with Provision Data Services could resolve whether Live Oak Data Center is operational, what power it consumes, and whether it matters to the regional AI infrastructure picture.
